article_ai_agents.summary: One person can now direct a team of AI agents that research, write, code and check each other's work. This article examines multi-agent automation: what it does to productivity, where quality control breaks, who is responsible for the output, and what it means to 'manage' work you did not do.
article_ai_agents.title: The Age of AI Agents: One Human, Many Minds

article_kids_food_breakfast.summary: Breakfast is the first meal of the day. After reading this you can say what breakfast is for, name breakfasts from around the world, and make a simple breakfast for yourself at home.
article_kids_food_breakfast.title: What's for Breakfast?
